selection_reason: APM-04 completed_verified in PR #435. CSW-02, CSW-04 and CSW-06 satisfy CSW-07 dependencies; the owner-approved interleave selects CSW-07 before CSW-08.
objective: Define a Writing Studio and Revision Workspace for longform and shortform creator prose with recoverable autosave/history, branches and comparison, Story Bible fact/reference support, outline/fragment-to-draft flows, governed-object links, export/handout boundaries and explicit optional-assistance apply/reject behavior while keeping writer-authored prose, creative possibility and governed facts semantically distinct.
design_findings: WritingDocument is an editable prose container rather than an owning-domain truth object.
DocumentBranch isolates alternate prose history without branching linked Campaign/World/Adventure state.
WorkingDraft/autosave provides recoverability while immutable DocumentRevision records meaningful historical boundaries.
Autosave frequency is intentionally separate from user-facing revision granularity.
Outline/fragment/workflow-to-draft creates independent prose with exact source provenance and no silent reverse propagation.
Story Bible/reference context retains governed/current/pinned/private/creative/note/open-thread distinctions rather than flattening everything into facts.
Linked governed-reference changes produce stale evidence while prose remains untouched.
CSW-06 candidates are advisory side evidence and cannot auto-edit or auto-resolve.
Creator style/voice/terminology profiles are preferences, not objective quality rules.
Writing assistance is candidate-only with explicit compare/apply/reject or partial apply and attribution.
Optional AI cannot auto-apply, publish, promote truth, resolve continuity or broaden access; no-AI core editing remains complete.
Ambiguous collaborative conflicts preserve both authored variants instead of silent last-writer-wins.
Campaign reconnect revalidates authority and cannot transfer protected Campaign-private content into Personal ownership.
Export/handout projections apply recipient visibility separately and bind to exact document revisions.
Accessibility/mobile parity covers edit, history, branching, comparison, references, recovery, conflict resolution and export without drag/color/canvas dependence.
CSW-08 receives exact revisions/spans/provenance as immutable source evidence for derivative/remix operations.
next_action: Open bounded CSW-07 governance PR, run exact-head AIOC repository-health, merge after PASS, then record completed_verified evidence and select CSW-08.
